# Maximus AI Strategic Advisory
# https://maximusintel.com
# Last updated: 2026-11-08

## About

Maximus AI Strategic Advisory brings enterprise-grade strategy and competitive intelligence to small and mid-size businesses: the kind of work large companies have long bought from consulting firms, at a fraction of the cost and time. Specialist AI agents research in parallel, quality gates remove anything unsourced, and a person owns every recommendation.

Founder: Joel Winns, based in Jupiter, Florida. The company is named after his son, a United States Marine, Military Police. The shield in the logo stands for protection: helping business owners keep pace as competitors adopt AI.

Promise: Designed to give your business the ultimate competitive edge.

## Services

### Free Competitive Edge Report
URL: https://maximusintel.com/free-report
A free report delivered in 48 hours: market position, top competitors, an AI visibility check (whether AI answer engines recommend the business), the biggest revenue leak and a 90-day plan. No credit card, no sales call.

### Strategic Intelligence Bible
URL: https://maximusintel.com/intelligence
A four-dimension competitive map: The Mirror (how the business looks to customers and AI engines), The Voice (what customers say), The Battlefield (competitors) and The Gold Mine (uncaptured revenue). One-time or refreshed monthly.

### AI Operational Audit
URL: https://maximusintel.com/ai-audit
Finds the hours and money lost to manual work AI can handle, with cost, expected savings and break-even for each fix (labeled estimates) and a 90-day roadmap.

### Growth Simulator
URL: https://maximusintel.com/growth
A free, in-browser model: enter your numbers, choose tasks to delegate to AI and compare three growth scenarios over 36 months. All assumptions visible; nothing is sent or stored.

### Maximus AIOS
URL: https://maximusintel.com/services
A Maximus AI operating system built into a business (lead capture, follow-up, AI receptionist, competitive intelligence), designed and managed with the client.

### The Agent Revolution (book, forthcoming)
URL: https://maximusintel.com/book
By Joel Winns. On what AI agents mean for business and work.

## Trust

Every Maximus agent works under the Joel Maximus Integrity Mandate: no invented numbers, clients or quotes; estimates labeled as estimates; anything irreversible waits for a human decision. Details: https://maximusintel.com/trust
